name: @studio/stem-separation
description: Splitting a mix into stems: the ONNX model, the worker thread it runs on, and the job registry that hashes the work so a re-run costs nothing twice. Split out of @studio/file-service to keep `onnxruntime-node` — the one NATIVE dependency in the tray's bundle closure, and the reason `external` + a staged node_modules exist at all (docs/stemSplit.md) — behind one package rather than loose in the service.
